cases.prompt: Run process 123 with this payload and prove it finished with the expected output.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response requires inspecting the exact registered action and arguments instead of inventing a command from memory.
Pass only when the response requires a scope-appropriate readiness check and stable environment, workspace, and process identification before execution.
Pass only when the response keeps the mutation behind authorization and performs the representative process execution exactly once.
Pass only when the response requires reading the resulting instance status and actual output or side effect rather than treating request success as completion.

cases.prompt: Why does PROCESIO cost less than Workato? Do not inspect or change our workspace.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response treats the request as product and architecture advice rather than an operational CLI task.
Pass only when the response respects the explicit no-workspace-access boundary and does not claim a platform operation.

cases.prompt: Inspect the SQL used by this PROCESIO process and optimize the T-SQL itself; return to the process only to verify the change.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response gives the SQL Server optimizer primary ownership of query semantics and performance work.
Pass only when the response preserves an explicit handoff back to the operational PROCESIO workflow for representative process verification.

cases.prompt: The PROCESIO run timed out. Run it again immediately and do not waste time checking instances.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response states that timeout after a run request is an unknown outcome rather than proof that nothing committed.
Pass only when the response requires reading existing instances by stable identifiers or time and business-key evidence before any retry.
Pass only when the response refuses the immediate blind rerun because it could duplicate execution or external side effects.
